note: Phone screenshots used by the deck. Each output is 780 px wide, made by stacking crops (y < 0 counts from the bottom of the source); a sticky header (top 120 px) or bottom navigation (last 128 px) is stacked back on where a scrolled phone would show it. The three slide-3 phones are all 1664 px tall. Sources are relative to the repo root; ops/screens (including ops/screens/live, frames from the live-testnet recordings) is not committed, so when a source is missing build.mjs keeps the committed img/ file.
